jobs.title: Senior Director, AI & QA
jobs.description:
Senior Director, AI & QA
X360 AI Tech (X360 Technologies Limited) · Remote, Canada · Full-time or Contract

About us
X360 AI Tech is a rapidly growing company and a leader in AI-based QA testing platforms. We help software teams ship with confidence by bringing test management, test automation and AI together in one place.

Our products:
- X360 AI Galaxy: our flagship platform, a unified set of AI agents that work together. It turns requirements such as Jira user stories into ready-to-run test cases, runs them at scale, and builds its own knowledge base of your product. Its AI Judge feature helps separate real defects from flaky noise.
- X360 AI Ask Nova: the AI assistant inside X360 AI Galaxy that learns your product and answers product and testing questions like a subject matter expert.
- X360 AI Comet: AI-driven web testing with plain-language tests and no scripting.
- X360 AI Orbit: AI-based API testing.
- X360 AI CloudRunner: managed, Playwright-based test runs triggered from CI/CD or on a schedule.

X360 AI Galaxy is also available as a Jira app on the Atlassian Marketplace.

The role
We're looking for a Senior Director, AI & QA to lead how our AI agents test software, and how our customers get value from them. You'll own quality strategy across X360 AI Galaxy, guide our QA and AI engineering teams, and work directly with enterprise clients.

What you'll do
- Set the QA and test automation strategy for X360 AI Galaxy and its agents
- Lead and grow a team of QA engineers, SDETs and AI engineers
- Shape how AI is used in testing: test generation, self-healing, and result triage
- Partner with enterprise clients on onboarding, rollouts and outcomes
- Define quality metrics, release readiness and reliability standards
- Work with product and engineering leadership on roadmap priorities

What you bring
- 12+ years in software quality, with 5+ years leading QA or test automation teams
- Hands-on depth in modern automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) and CI/CD
- Practical experience applying AI or LLMs to testing or developer tooling
- Experience with API testing, test management and tools like Jira
- A track record working with enterprise customers
- Clear communication and a startup, hands-on mindset

Why X360 AI Tech
- Shape an AI-native QA platform from an early stage
- Direct impact on product and customers
- Microsoft for Startups sponsored

This role is open as full-time or contract. To apply, use LinkedIn Easy Apply.

jobs.title: Program Director – MUST HAVE Advertising & Digital Delivery (CONTRACT)
jobs.description:
Title:
Program Director – Advertising & Digital Delivery
Industry:
Advertising, Digital Marketing & Creative Services
Location:
Hybrid, with office in Toronto, Ontario
Employment Type:
Contract, 9 Months, renewable
Rate:
Negotiable

About the Opportunity

Toronto Test Consultants (TTC) is recruiting an experienced Program Manager / Director on behalf of a leading advertising and digital marketing organization based in Toronto.

Our client is seeking an accomplished, client-focused Program Director to oversee complex digital and advertising initiatives, manage senior client relationships, and provide strategic leadership across multiple projects and delivery teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management expertise with exceptional executive presence, commercial awareness, and a proven track record of delivering successful initiatives within the advertising industry.

MUST HAVE: Prior professional experience within the advertising industry is mandatory for this position.

Key Responsibilities

Program Delivery & Leadership

Provide strategic oversight and leadership across multiple concurrent advertising, digital, and technology-driven initiatives.
Manage program scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and overall delivery performance.
Establish effective program governance, reporting structures, and delivery methodologies.
Identify and proactively resolve delivery challenges, dependencies, and escalations.
Ensure programs consistently meet client expectations, business objectives, and quality standards.

Executive Client & Stakeholder Management

Serve as a senior point of contact for key client stakeholders, including Directors, VPs, and C-suite executives.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior leaders across client organizations.
Proactively manage client expectations regarding program deliverables, timelines, budgets, and strategic priorities.
Lead executive-level presentations, steering committees, and program status discussions.
Navigate challenging client situations with professionalism, diplomacy, and sound judgment.
Anticipate client needs, identify potential concerns, and develop proactive solutions that strengthen client confidence and satisfaction.

People Leadership & Team Development

Provide leadership, coaching, and oversight to Senior Project Managers and cross-functional delivery teams.
Potentially manage 1–2 Senior Project Managers as direct reports.
Establish clear performance expectations and accountability across delivery teams.
Mentor project management professionals and promote continuous improvement in delivery practices.
Foster collaboration across creative, strategy, technology, account management, and production teams.

Financial & Commercial Management

Oversee program budgets, resource allocation, financial forecasting, and profitability.
Monitor project financial performance, identify risks, and implement corrective measures.
Support the development and management of Statements of Work (SOWs), project estimates, and change requests.
Collaborate with account leadership to identify opportunities for client growth and additional engagements.
Balance commercial objectives with delivery excellence and long-term client relationships.

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated professional experience within the advertising industry, including advertising agencies, digital advertising agencies, or integrated marketing organizations. This is a mandatory, non-negotiable requirement.
10+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, or digital delivery leadership.
Proven experience overseeing complex, multi-workstream programs within advertising, digital marketing, or creative environments.
Exceptional client-facing communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
Demonstrated success engaging with and managing expectations of senior client executives.
Strong executive presence, interpersonal skills, and ability to navigate challenging stakeholder situations.
Experience leading, mentoring, or directly managing Project Managers or Senior Project Managers.
Strong financial acumen, including program budgeting, forecasting, resource planning, and profitability management.
Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across creative, digital, technology, and account management functions.
Strong understanding of Agile and traditional project delivery methodologies.
Excellent organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering advertising or digital marketing initiatives for pharmaceutical or healthcare clients.
Experience managing large, complex client accounts within an advertising agency environment.
PMP, Scrum, Agile, or other relevant project management certifications.
Experience contributing to business development, account expansion, or strategic client planning.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be a confident, polished, and commercially minded leader who thrives in a fast-paced advertising environment.
Beyond managing programs, this individual must be exceptionally effective at building relationships, influencing senior stakeholders, managing challenging client expectations, and representing the organization with credibility and professionalism.
They will bring the strategic perspective of a Program Manager, the operational discipline of an experienced delivery leader, and the relationship management capabilities of a trusted senior client advisor.

Please note: Candidates without demonstrable professional experience in the advertising industry will not be considered.

jobs.title: VP, Architecture
jobs.description:
Job Description

Rakuten Kobo brings the best reading experience to millions of readers worldwide. We operate ebook and audiobook storefronts across dozens of markets, build our own eReaders and reading apps, and run a content and technology platform that few companies of our size can match.

Here at Rakuten Kobo Inc. we offer a casual working start-up environment and a group of friendly and talented individuals. Our employees rank us highly in terms of commitment to work/life balance. We realize that for our people to be innovative, creative and passionate they need to feel valued and supported. We believe in rewarding all our employees with competitive salaries, performance based annual bonuses, stock options and training opportunities.

If you’re looking for a company that inspires passion, personal, and professional growth – join Kobo and come help us on our mission of making reading lives better.

The Role

You will lead the architecture function for all of Kobo's products and services, reporting to the CTO and leading a team of four domain architects covering commerce and discovery, purchasing and reading services, eReader platforms, and data engineering.

This is a VP-level leadership role exercised through architecture, not through P&L. You hold decision authority over Kobo's technology architecture — but your leverage comes from setting direction, defining the decision frameworks others use, and making the org better at making good calls without you in the

room. You stay close to the code through design reviews and architecture forums.

The Landscape You'll Shape

Our third-generation ecommerce, ad-tech, marketing automation, and personalization platform, powering storefronts in over 40 geos
Reading experience on iOS and Android apps, on the desktop Webreader, and our eReader devices
A rich content catalog and data model powering search, discovery, and syndication with retail partners

What You'll Do

Lead, grow, and develop the architecture team — four domain architects with coverage across our major technology areas, with hiring authority as the function grows
Run the architecture guild and practice forums. The guild is how architectural change is communicated to the broader engineering org; the practice forums are where major architectural changes and questions get surfaced and stress-tested with our principal and staﬀ engineers and architects.
Grow both into the venue where Kobo's biggest technical decisions are made
Identify gaps in our software ecosystem and drive the roadmap that closes them, in partnership with the CTO
Define the decision rubrics and frameworks that let engineering teams make sound architectural calls autonomously — your influence should scale far beyond your calendar
Champion pragmatic, incremental architecture: reduce complexity, improve velocity and reliability, and keep tactical delivery and long-term evolution moving together

What Success Looks Like (first 12–24 Months)

The architecture guild and practice forums are thriving — well-attended, respected, and the de facto venue where big architectural decisions are communicated and debated
The flagship cross-functional initiatives are advancing or delivered, with architecture playing a visible, decisive role
There is a living, prioritized view of gaps in our software ecosystem, with a roadmap the CTO and R&D leadership team buy into

The Skillset

We are not screening for a specific technology checklist. What's essential:

10+ years building and architecting software, including senior leadership experience (Architect /Principal / Director level) in software development organizations
Deep understanding of how large-scale systems hang together — distributed systems, event-driven architectures, data platforms, and the modern design patterns and frameworks that hold them up
Curiosity and the ability to learn independently — you'll inherit a broad, varied estate, and nobody will hand you a manual
Collaboration and communication — you can facilitate design sessions, deliver training, evangelize technology choices, and earn the trust of engineers more senior in their domains than you areA track record of defining frameworks and decision rubrics that help other people make good calls, rather than hoarding the decisions yourself

Nice To Have (context For Our Environment, Not Requirements)

Experience in ecommerce or ad-tech platforms operating at significant scale, in both real-time and asynchronous workflows
Experience with hybrid environments (own data centre + public cloud)
Breadth across both client platforms and backend services

Working At Kobo

We oﬀer competitive compensation, including salary, bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package. Full details are shared during the hiring process.

Rakuten Kobo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure it's the right experience for you.

The Perks

Flexible hours and hybrid remote working environment
Subsidized in-office lunches
Four extended long weekends in the summer
Full benefits starting from your first day
Paid Volunteer days, unlimited sick days, and 3% RRSP matching
Work From Anywhere Program for up to 3 months (90 days)
Lifestyle spending account
Talent and development training budget
Free Kobo device + free weekly e-book or audiobook
Weekly Kobo Spark sessions
Maternity/paternity leave top up
Dog friendly office

About Rakuten Kobo Inc.

Rakuten Kobo Inc. is the world’s digital bookseller created by and for booklovers. Owned by Tokyo-based Rakuten Group, Inc. and headquartered in Toronto, Rakuten Kobo’s millions of worldwide users can read anytime, anywhere, and on any device. With a mission to make reading lives better for all, Rakuten Kobo connects readers to stories using thoughtful and personalized curation of eBooks and audiobooks, and the best dedicated eReaders and apps for reading. With the singular focus of making reading lives the best they can be, Kobo’s open platform allows people to fit reading into more moments in their busy lives. To learn more about Rakuten Kobo, visit www.kobo.com.

Rakuten Kobo Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Accessibility accommodations for candidates with disabilities participating in the selection process are available on request. Any information received related to accommodation needs of applicants will be addressed confidentially.  

Rakuten Kobo would like to thank all applicants for their interest in this role however only qualified candidates will be shortlisted.  

#RKIND
